implementation_notes: Put the knowledge in a `static` class or `const`/`static readonly` field, or in an interface default member when it is behaviour. Constants declared in an interface leak into every implementor, so prefer a dedicated static holder class over scattering them.
idiom_name: static class as the authoritative home for shared rules
pitfalls: Const strings for messages that must stay in sync with resources
Extension methods in too many namespaces become undiscoverable duplicates
